parameters.content:
# Flashpoint · Eval (LLM as a judge)
Checks how well the agent performs. Every analysis logged by the main workflow is graded twice: by **7 hard rule checks** in code and by a **judge model from a different model family**, so the analyst never grades itself. Results go to the **Evals** tab and a summary e-mail.

## 1 · Load
Runs daily at 18:00 or on demand. Reads the **Analyses** and **Evals** tabs and keeps only analyses that were not judged yet.

## 2 · Grade
**Rule checks** (no model): unsubscribe line, no e-mail addresses, evidence behind claims, score range, reasons for high scores, auto e-mail only when verified.
**LLM judge**: groundedness, relevance, actionability, e-mail quality, compliance, calibration (1-5).

## 3 · Report
Pass = all rules green, average at least 3.5, groundedness at least 3, compliance at least 4. Rows go to **Evals**; the team gets averages, rule failures and the three weakest analyses.

# Legend · Flashpoint eval workflow
Every node, in order. **Phase** · what it does · *API* · cost per account.


### 1 Load
- **Run evaluation now**: Start the evaluation by hand. *(Manual Trigger, free)*
- **Every day at 18:00**: Runs the evaluation every evening. *(Schedule Trigger, free)*
- **Read analyses**: All analyses the main workflow logged. *(Google Sheets, free)*
- **Read evals**: All analyses that were already judged. *(Google Sheets, free)*
- **Select unjudged**: Keeps only analyses without a verdict, at most 20 per run. *(Code, free)*

### 2 Grade
- **Rule checks**: 7 deterministic checks: STOP line, no e-mail addresses, e-mail length, score range, reasons for high scores, evidence behind pain claims, auto e-mail only when verified. *(Code, free)*
- **LLM judge**: A different model family grades 6 criteria from 1 to 5: groundedness, relevance, actionability, e-mail quality, compliance, calibration. *(Featherless DeepSeek-V3, flat plan)*
- **Parse verdict**: Combines rules and grades into pass / fail / judge-error. *(Code, free)*

### 3 Report
- **Write to Evals tab**: Appends one row per judged analysis to the Evals tab. *(Google Sheets, free)*
- **Build report**: Averages per criterion, rule failures and the three weakest analyses. *(Code, free)*
- **Anything judged?**: Skips the e-mail when nothing new was judged. *(n8n IF, free)*
- **E-mail eval team**: Sends the report to the eval team. *(Gmail, free)*
